source: Photosynthesis is the biochemical process by which plants convert light energy into chemical energy stored in glucose.
target: Plants use sunlight to make food. This food is a sugar called glucose.

source: An operating system is system software that manages computer hardware and provides services for application programs.
target: An operating system is a program that controls the computer. It helps other programs run.

source: Neural networks are computational models inspired by the biological neural networks that constitute animal brains.
target: Neural networks are computer models. They work a bit like the brain.

source: The mitochondria are organelles that generate most of the cell's supply of adenosine triphosphate.
target: Mitochondria are small parts inside a cell. They make most of the cell's energy.

source: Evaporation occurs when liquid water absorbs heat and transforms into water vapour.
target: Evaporation is when water gets hot and turns into gas.

source: Gravity is the force by which a planet draws objects toward its centre.
target: Gravity is a force. It pulls things towards the Earth.

source: The respiratory system facilitates gas exchange between the organism and its environment.
target: The respiratory system helps us breathe. We take in air and give out gas.

source: Democracy is a system of government in which power is vested in the people, who exercise it directly or through elected representatives.
target: Democracy is a way of running a country. The people choose their leaders by voting.

source: A database is an organised collection of structured information stored electronically in a computer system.
target: A database is a place on a computer where information is stored in an organised way.

source: Deforestation refers to the large-scale removal of trees, resulting in the degradation of ecosystems.
target: Deforestation means cutting down many trees. This harms nature.

source: The water cycle describes the continuous movement of water on, above, and below the surface of the Earth.
target: The water cycle is how water moves around the Earth again and again.

source: Algorithms are finite sequences of well-defined instructions used to solve a class of problems.
target: An algorithm is a list of clear steps to solve a problem.

source: Inflation is the rate at which the general level of prices for goods and services rises, eroding purchasing power.
target: Inflation is when prices go up. Then your money buys less.

source: The heart is a muscular organ that pumps blood throughout the circulatory system.
target: The heart is a muscle. It pushes blood around the body.

source: Photosynthesis takes place primarily in the chloroplasts, which contain the pigment chlorophyll.
target: Photosynthesis happens in parts of the leaf called chloroplasts. They hold a green colour called chlorophyll.

source: Machine learning enables computers to learn patterns from data without being explicitly programmed.
target: Machine learning lets computers learn from data. Nobody has to write every rule.

source: A fraction represents a part of a whole, expressed as a numerator divided by a denominator.
target: A fraction shows a part of something. It has a top number and a bottom number.

source: Condensation is the process whereby water vapour cools and changes into liquid droplets.
target: Condensation is when water gas gets cold and turns back into water drops.

source: The Constitution is the supreme law of the country and outlines the fundamental rights of citizens.
target: The Constitution is the main law of the country. It lists the basic rights of people.

source: Renewable energy is derived from natural sources that are replenished continuously, such as sunlight and wind.
target: Renewable energy comes from things that do not run out, like sun and wind.

source: A compiler translates source code written in a high-level language into machine code.
target: A compiler changes the code we write into code the computer can understand.

source: Biodiversity encompasses the variety of all living organisms within a particular habitat.
target: Biodiversity means all the different kinds of living things in one place.

source: Osmosis is the diffusion of water molecules across a semipermeable membrane from lower to higher solute concentration.
target: Osmosis is when water moves through a thin wall. It moves to the side with more dissolved material.

source: The internet is a global network of interconnected computers that communicate using standardised protocols.
target: The internet is a worldwide network of computers. They share information using common rules.

source: Photosynthesis requires carbon dioxide, water, and sunlight to produce oxygen and glucose.
target: Plants need air, water and sunlight. They make oxygen and sugar.

source: Erosion is the gradual wearing away of rock and soil by wind, water, or ice.
target: Erosion is when wind, water or ice slowly takes away rock and soil.

source: A noun is a word that denotes a person, place, thing, or idea.
target: A noun is a word for a person, place, thing or idea.

source: Magnets exert a force that attracts ferromagnetic materials such as iron.
target: Magnets pull things made of iron.

source: The digestive system breaks down food into nutrients that the body can absorb.
target: The digestive system cuts food into tiny parts. The body takes what it needs.

source: Cloud computing delivers computing services over the internet on a pay-as-you-go basis.
target: Cloud computing gives you computer services through the internet. You pay only for what you use.
